notes.note: Titan does not support automatic typing (clause 6.5, 'var v := 2;'); syntax is valid per A.1.6.3.1 VarInstance ([TypeOrNestedTypeDef] optional).
Terminology: TypeOrNestedParDef read as TypeOrNestedTypeDef. Titan does not support automatic typing; test is valid per BNF rule 260.
Titan rejects @deterministic on variables (only supports it on class properties); allowed by clause 11.1 syntax and BNF rule 260.
Literal reading chosen: component variable used in testcase, function and altstep whose runs on clause is exactly the declaring component type.
Titan rejects @deterministic on variables and automatic typing; both are part of the syntactical structure of clause 11.1.
Ambiguous error kind; dynamic-error reading chosen (ttcn3verdict:error). A tool detecting it statically would reject instead.
Titan does not implement the check that lazy/fuzzy variables used in alt guards (snapshot evaluation) must be @deterministic (16.1.4 m).
Standard requires a dynamic error on evaluation (example in 11.1); Titan already reports the self-reference at compile time, which is stricter than the standard.
Checked as a runtime error (ttcn3verdict:error) since initialization state is in general only known at runtime.
Titan does not support variables of timer type ('var timer'); allowed per clauses 11.0 and 11.1 example. Assumes the timer variable refers to the assigned timer instance.
